description: A scripted run of the demo API over transparency-dataset.json#/store for the MOD2 tables, one call at a time: the function, its arguments, the outcome (`ok` with the result, `error` with the message) and the store delta per collection (`added` records, `removed` ids, `changed` whole new records). Covers the flow node, transaction, proof counting, node visibility, embed config, chain and trust score writes the demo API has, and the reads whose rules the module mirrors (flow data, organisation stats, chain counts, chain trust score, chain activity log, trust history, campaign report). Chain activity of a cancelled request is not reachable through the API, so it shows as removed.

env.defined_at: rust/tools/src/transparency.ts#withFrozenClock: replaces Date and crypto.randomUUID while the demo API runs (it has no LedgerEnv)
env.new_id: 00000000-0000-4000-8000- then n left-padded with 0 to 12 digits, n = 1, 2, 3, ... (a UUID v4 shape), one per crypto.randomUUID() call
